Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This 
 document outlines the equipment tests I2, which must performed on an annually 
 bases as indicated by Y1 in the titled block
The first draft initiated by eng. 
Salah Kamel Mostafa (HV-Dep. Manager), tested by eng. 
Sahar Mohamed Ali, accepted by eng. 
Sayed Mahmoud 
Hessain Farag; general director, revised by EDEPC inspection and quality control eng. Adel Abd 
El-Qader El-Nagar, approved by eng. 
Mokhtar Abdel 
Latif Mady head sector of Ataka PS.
This document accepted by eng. 
Samir Abdel Gilil: EDEPC MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud 
Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, and quality control general 
director and supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category,
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the 
 work area is required,
Wear safety and health equipment as safety 
 helmet, shoes, 
 ... etc.
Potential transformer must be isolated and proper grounded is required
Wear safety 
 belt because there is danger of falling off the top of the PT stack when cleaning 
 insulators or checking connections.
Presence the safety 
 supervisor is required.
Caution: Secondary PT wiring could be energized 
 through back feeds, make sure circuit breaker to secondary circuit is open
The secondary circuits for the PT should be opened
Tools 
and Equipment
Safety helmet, safety shoes, safety belt, and silicagel
Safety helmet, safety shoes, safety belt, and silicagel
Voltage indicator.
Cleaning tools as cloth, rags .... etc
Multimeter, Air blower,
Screwdrivers and set of common keys.
Works to be Carried Out
Check PT foundation to ensure it is in correct vertical position.
Examine the surface of the porcelain for scratches, chips, and flash over 
 burns, and cracks.
Check and retighten if necessary all mounting bolts of voltage transformer.
Check the oil level on the oil level gauge.
Check for oil leaks.
Check the primary and secondary terminals, and retighten all joints.
Check and clean terminals box inside and out.
Check there has been no flash over on air gap for secondary terminals and 
 communication.
Check the terminals box gasket, repair if required.
Clean PT porcelain.
The main grounding connection must be checked and retightened if necessary.
